what_changed: Folds the Apify strong-match-backlog recovery into the sentiment layer. The strong-match 'submitted-empty' bucket (9,551 URLs) was re-scraped and found to be ~10.8% RECOVERABLE (transient failures in the original Feb-Mar scrape, NOT genuine empties): 1,054 distinct profiles / 136,959 posts recovered (+6.7% profiles, +4.7% posts on the 15,670-profile / ~2.9M-post corpus). New posts were LM-scored (sentiment_analysis_full.py; FinBERT columns left NaN -- LM-only this round) and folded in. company_sentiment_annual/quarterly were RE-AGGREGATED on the expanded corpus and VERIFIED (see verification). posts_scored_unique and posts_full_coverage are the EXPANDED corpus (existing 2026-05-27 + the recovered posts, header-stripped append). All other files are symlink-inherited UNCHANGED from 2026-06-07_crsp_monthly. `current` NOT flipped.

verification.reproduction_gate: PASS -- aggregate_sentiment.py reproduces the existing company_sentiment_annual_20260527 byte-for-byte on all 54,466 company-years before any new data was added (src/data_analysis/verify_aggregation_repro.py).
verification.unchanged_companies_cell_level: PASS -- every (company_name_clean, gvkey, ticker, year/quarter) cell that received ZERO new posts is identical to the canonical panel within rtol/atol 1e-6: annual 50,687/50,687, quarterly 147,880/147,880, 0 drifted.
verification.memory_safe_load: full_coverage read with usecols (drops post_text); pandas tokenizes the full row before applying usecols, so on_bad_lines skipping is identical to a full read -- faithful.

strong_match_definition: company_sentiment uses the EXISTING panel's revelio source: data/revelio/revelio_validation_summary.csv (v1) `strong_match` (strict, single-tier) -- this is what reproduces the canonical panel exactly, so unchanged companies stay identical (guardrail). All 1,053 recovered URLs are present in v1; v1 strong_match=True for 979 of them. 52 recovered profiles are strong under v2 `strong_match_either` (Tier-2 headline) but not v1 strict; applying the Tier-2 lift panel-wide would change EXISTING companies' n_strong_match_posts (fails the unchanged-companies check) and is therefore deferred to a separate methodology-change release, not this one. NOTE: the firm panel's strong-subset (build_multifreq_panel) already uses `strong_match_either` -- that is unchanged here because the firm panel is inherited, not rebuilt (see firm_panel note).
firm_panel_note: firm_panel_annual.dta and firm_panel_quarterly.dta are INHERITED UNCHANGED (do NOT reflect the new posts). A re-scored firm panel was attempted via build_multifreq_panel.py but REJECTED by the verification gate: that script is a SEPARATE unfiltered product (32,049 firm-years, revelio strong_match_either) and is NOT the canonical .dta's builder (the .dta has 19,858 filtered firm-years: n_posts>=1, 2013-2024, financials-joined); 52 unchanged firm-years drifted on n_posts/n_persons. Per the stop-and-report guardrail, no drifted panel was shipped. FOLLOW-UP (planning 2026-06-15; off Chat 6's plate -> dedicated unified-reconciliation chat): the BASE firm/person panels are built by build_stata_handoff.py (build_firm_panel/build_firm_quarterly + person_year/person_lifetime, from company_sentiment + posts_scored_unique) -- re-run THAT on the new company_sentiment, then re-apply def14a board-composition via build_def14a_merge_release.py (which only merges, does not aggregate sentiment) + the age join, with a reproduction gate. See docs/handoffs/unified_reconciliation_release_spec_20260615.md.
